Run STEAM trajectory analysis (supervised).

# Load libraries

Load the necessary libraries.
```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(Seurat)
library(SeuratObject)
library(dplyr)
library(MASS)
library(viridis)
library(stringr)
library(patchwork)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(STEAM)
library(tidyr)
library(reshape2)
library(ggnewscale)
```


# Load data

Load Seurat object.
```{r}
se <- readRDS("Seurat_objects/Postnatal_human_seurat_v5_GNxEarly_filtered_trajectory_lineage_cells_harmony_no_outliers.rds")
se
head(se[[]])
```


Load ranked gene lists (here from Open Targets). Please note that it is essential for downstream analysis that the gene lists are ranked from this point forward to do empirical selection of top genetic genes.
```{r class.source = 'fold-show'}

OpenTargets_MDD_Genetic_ <- as.character(t(read.table(file = "data/OpenTargets/ranked_gene_sets/OT-MONDO_0002009-associated-targets-9_15_2026-v26_06_weights_genetics_only_MDD_ranked.csv")))
length(OpenTargets_MDD_Genetic_)

```


# Prepare data for STEAM analysis

Filter out genes not present in the Seurat object.
```{r}
# Extract gene names from the Seurat object
gene_names <- rownames(se)

# Remove genes not present in the Seurat object from the gene lists
OpenTargets_MDD_Genetic_ <- unique(OpenTargets_MDD_Genetic_[OpenTargets_MDD_Genetic_ %in% gene_names])
length(OpenTargets_MDD_Genetic_)

OpenTargets_MDD_Genetic_top_ <- OpenTargets_MDD_Genetic_[1:160]
length(OpenTargets_MDD_Genetic_top_)
```


Generate sliding window gene sets from gene lists. Select your choice of trait abbreviation (disease_abbr) and a gene list descriptive term (ot_gene_set_label). We select a window size of 50 genes, moving by 10 genes for each window.
```{r, eval=T}
window_rank_list_MDD_Genetic <- generate_sliding_windows(OpenTargets_MDD_Genetic_, window_size = 50, step_size = 10, disease_abbr = "MDD", ot_gene_set_label = "Genetic")
```


Add gene sets to a list.
```{r, eval=T}
all_gene_sets_OpenTargets <- list(OpenTargets_MDD_Genetic_=OpenTargets_MDD_Genetic_,OpenTargets_MDD_Genetic_top_=OpenTargets_MDD_Genetic_top_)
```


Merge all gene sets into one list.
```{r, eval=T}
all_gene_sets <- all_gene_sets_OpenTargets
all_gene_sets <- append(all_gene_sets,window_rank_list_MDD_Genetic)
```


Calculate the average gene expression per gene list and check the percentage of genes present in the Seurat object. It is important that all genes used are present in the Seurat object, otherwise the downstream statistic assumptions are invalid.
```{r, eval=T}
score.mat <- matrix(data = NA, nrow = length(all_gene_sets), ncol = 1, dimnames = list(names(all_gene_sets), "% of genes present"))

for (i in 1:length(all_gene_sets)) {
  genes <- unlist(all_gene_sets[i]) 
  score.mat[i] <- mean(genes %in% rownames(se))
  se <- AddModuleScore(se,list(genes), ctrl = 100, name = list(names(all_gene_sets[i])))
}

score.mat*100
```

Look at the Open Targets sliding window score patterns to empirically pick top genes. This selection can also be assisted by the pattern score (max of LOESS R² and Linear R²).
```{r}
generate_trait_score_trajectory <- function(
    seurat_obj, 
    meta_prefix, 
    n_vars, 
    rank_var = "MetaCell_rank",     
    ncol = 9, 
    point_alpha = 0.3, 
    point_size = 0.8, 
    smooth_color = "red", 
    show_se = TRUE
) {
  
  # Construct variable names
  vars <- paste0(meta_prefix, 1:n_vars, "_1")
  
  # Fetch data, including the chosen ranking variable
  df <- FetchData(seurat_obj, vars = c(rank_var, vars))
  
  # Reshape data
  df_long <- pivot_longer(df, cols = vars, names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") %>%
    mutate(variable = factor(variable, levels = vars))
  
  # ----- pattern score calculation -----
  calc_pattern_score <- function(df_sub) {
    lm_fit <- lm(value ~ df_sub[[rank_var]], data = df_sub)
    r2_lm <- summary(lm_fit)$r.squared
    
    loess_fit <- loess(value ~ df_sub[[rank_var]], data = df_sub)
    pred_loess <- predict(loess_fit)
    r2_loess <- 1 - (sum((df_sub$value - pred_loess)^2) /
                     sum((df_sub$value - mean(df_sub$value))^2))
    
    tibble(
      variable = unique(df_sub$variable),
      r2_linear = r2_lm,
      r2_loess = r2_loess,
      pattern_score = max(r2_lm, r2_loess)
    )
  }
  
  pattern_scores <- df_long %>%
    group_split(variable) %>%
    purrr::map_dfr(calc_pattern_score)
  
  # ----- plot -----
  p <- ggplot(df_long, aes_string(rank_var, "value")) +   # <- aes_string allows dynamic x-variable
    geom_point(alpha = point_alpha, size = point_size) +
    geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = show_se, color = smooth_color) +
    facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free_y", ncol = ncol) +
    theme_classic() +
    xlab(rank_var) +
    ylab("Window Score")
  
  # Attach pattern scores as attribute
  attr(p, "pattern_scores") <- pattern_scores
  return(p)
}

```

```{r, fig.width=20, fig.height=15, eval=T}
)
```

## Assign pseudotime windows


Assign and check pseudotime windows.

```{r}
assign_pseudotime_windows <- function(
  seurat_obj,
  pseudotime_col,
  mode = c("sliding", "stratified"),
  window_size = NULL,          # used in sliding mode
  windows_per_anno = NULL,     # used in stratified mode
  cell_anno_col = NULL,        # used in stratified mode
  output_col = "pseudotime_windows"
) {
  # Validate mode
  mode <- match.arg(mode)

  meta <- seurat_obj@meta.data
  meta[[output_col]] <- NA_character_

  if (mode == "sliding") {
    # ----- Argument check -----
    if (is.null(window_size)) stop("`window_size` must be provided when mode = 'sliding'")

    # Extract pseudotime
    pt_values <- meta[[pseudotime_col]]
    cells <- rownames(meta)

    df <- data.frame(
      cell = cells,
      pseudotime = pt_values,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )

    # Order cells by pseudotime
    df_ordered <- df[order(df$pseudotime, na.last = TRUE), , drop = FALSE]

    # Non-NA pseudotime
    non_na_idx <- which(!is.na(df_ordered$pseudotime))
    n_non_na <- length(non_na_idx)

    if (n_non_na == 0) {
      seurat_obj@meta.data[[output_col]] <- NA
      return(seurat_obj)
    }

    # Assign windows
    window_ids <- ceiling(seq_len(n_non_na) / window_size)

    # Merge last window if too small
    last_window_size <- n_non_na - (max(window_ids) - 1) * window_size
    if (last_window_size < window_size && max(window_ids) > 1) {
      window_ids[window_ids == max(window_ids)] <- max(window_ids) - 1
    }

    # Assign labels
    labels <- rep(NA_character_, nrow(df_ordered))
    labels[non_na_idx] <- paste0("pt_window_", window_ids)
    labels_by_cell <- setNames(labels, df_ordered$cell)
    meta[[output_col]] <- labels_by_cell[rownames(meta)]

  } else if (mode == "stratified") {
    # ----- Argument check -----
    if (is.null(windows_per_anno) || is.null(cell_anno_col)) {
      stop("`windows_per_anno` and `cell_anno_col` must be provided when mode = 'stratified'")
    }

    current_window_id <- 1  # global counter

    # Loop over each annotation
    for (anno in names(windows_per_anno)) {
      n_windows <- windows_per_anno[[anno]]

      # Cells in this annotation with valid pseudotime
      idx <- which(
        meta[[cell_anno_col]] == anno &
        !is.na(meta[[pseudotime_col]])
      )

      if (length(idx) == 0) {
        current_window_id <- current_window_id + n_windows
        next
      }

      # Order cells by pseudotime
      idx_ordered <- idx[order(meta[[pseudotime_col]][idx])]

      # Local window IDs
      local_ids <- cut(
        seq_along(idx_ordered),
        breaks = n_windows,
        labels = FALSE
      )

      # Map to global IDs
      global_ids <- local_ids + current_window_id - 1
      meta[[output_col]][idx_ordered] <- paste0("pt_window_", global_ids)

      # Advance global counter
      current_window_id <- current_window_id + n_windows
    }
  }

  seurat_obj@meta.data <- meta
  return(seurat_obj)
}

```


```{r}
se <- assign_pseudotime_windows(
  se,
  pseudotime_col = "cell_rank_ordered",
  mode = "sliding",
  window_size = 110
)

table(se$pseudotime_windows)
```


Plot pseudotime window assignment.
```{r}
#library(dplyr)
#library(ggplot2)

# Extract metadata
meta <- se[[]]

# Set colors
cell_colors <- c(
  "NSC" = "#FC8D62",
  "INP" = "#E78AC3",
  "NB"  = "#8DA0CB",
  "YGN" = "#A6D854",
  "GN"  = "#66C2A5"
)

# Ensure cell_rank_ordered is a factor (discrete)
meta$cell_rank_ordered <- factor(
  meta$cell_rank_ordered,
  levels = sort(unique(meta$cell_rank_ordered)),
  ordered = TRUE
)

# Ensure pseudotime windows are ordered numerically
meta$pseudotime_windows <- factor(
  meta$pseudotime_windows,
  levels = paste0(
    "pt_window_",
    seq_len(max(
      as.numeric(gsub("pt_window_", "", meta$pseudotime_windows)),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ))
  ),
  ordered = TRUE
)

# Count cells per type per rank and compute fractions
plot_long <- meta %>%
  filter(cell_anno %in% names(cell_colors)) %>%
  count(cell_rank_ordered, cell_anno, name = "Count") %>%
  group_by(cell_rank_ordered) %>%
  mutate(Fraction = Count / sum(Count)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  rename(CellType = cell_anno)

plot_long$CellType <- factor(plot_long$CellType, levels = names(cell_colors))

# Compute window boundaries
window_bounds <- meta %>%
  filter(!is.na(pseudotime_windows)) %>%
  group_by(pseudotime_windows) %>%
  summarise(
    start = min(as.numeric(cell_rank_ordered)),
    end   = max(as.numeric(cell_rank_ordered)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(start)

# Vertical line positions (between windows)
vline_positions <- window_bounds$end[-nrow(window_bounds)] + 0.5

# Window label positions
window_labels <- window_bounds %>%
  mutate(xpos = (start + end) / 2)

# X-axis breaks and labels = start of each window
x_breaks <- window_bounds$start
x_labels <- window_bounds$start  # numeric ticks

# Plot
ggplot(plot_long, aes(x = cell_rank_ordered, y = Fraction, fill = CellType)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = vline_positions,
    linetype = "dotted",
    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = window_labels,
    aes(x = xpos, y = 1.05, label = pseudotime_windows),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    angle = 90,
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 0,
    size = 4
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cell_colors) +
  labs(
    x = "Cell rank",
    y = "Fraction of cells",
    title = "Cell type composition along trajectory with pseudotime windows"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.5))) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    breaks = levels(meta$cell_rank_ordered)[x_breaks],
    labels = x_labels
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1))

```

```{r}
# Set colors
cell_colors <- c(

  "INP" = "#E78AC3",
  "NB"  = "#8DA0CB",
  "YGN" = "#A6D854",
  "GN"  = "#66C2A5"
)

# Convert cell_rank_ordered to numeric factor positions
meta$cell_rank_numeric <- as.numeric(factor(
  meta$cell_rank_ordered,
  levels = sort(unique(meta$cell_rank_ordered)),
  ordered = TRUE
))

# Ensure pseudotime windows are ordered numerically
meta$pseudotime_windows <- factor(
  meta$pseudotime_windows,
  levels = paste0(
    "pt_window_",
    seq_len(max(
      as.numeric(gsub("pt_window_", "", meta$pseudotime_windows)),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ))
  ),
  ordered = TRUE
)

# Count cells per type per rank and compute fractions
plot_long <- meta %>%
  filter(cell_anno %in% names(cell_colors)) %>%
  count(cell_rank_numeric, cell_anno, name = "Count") %>%
  group_by(cell_rank_numeric) %>%
  mutate(Fraction = Count / sum(Count)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  rename(CellType = cell_anno)

plot_long$CellType <- factor(plot_long$CellType, levels = names(cell_colors))

# -------------------------------
# Compute window boundaries
# -------------------------------
window_bounds <- meta %>%
  filter(!is.na(pseudotime_windows)) %>%
  group_by(pseudotime_windows) %>%
  summarise(
    start = min(cell_rank_numeric),
    end   = max(cell_rank_numeric),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(start)

# -------------------------------
# Dashed line positions using factor positions
# -------------------------------
# Convert numeric ends to factor positions for robust plotting
vline_positions <- sapply(window_bounds$end[-nrow(window_bounds)], function(x) {
  which(plot_long$cell_rank_numeric == x)
})

# Window label positions (middle of window)
window_labels <- window_bounds %>%
  mutate(xpos = (start + end) / 2)

# -------------------------------
# X-axis breaks = last cell of each window
# -------------------------------
x_breaks <- sapply(window_bounds$end, function(x) {
  which(plot_long$cell_rank_numeric == x)
})

# -------------------------------
# Plot
# -------------------------------
p <- ggplot(plot_long, aes(x = cell_rank_numeric, y = Fraction, fill = CellType)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1) +

  # Dotted lines
  geom_vline(xintercept = vline_positions, linetype = "dotted", color = "black") +

  # Window labels
  geom_text(
    data = window_labels,
    aes(x = xpos, y = 1.05, label = pseudotime_windows),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    angle = 90,
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 0,
    size = 4
  ) +

  # Cell type colors
  scale_fill_manual(values = cell_colors) +

  # Labels
  labs(
    x = "Cell rank",
    y = "Fraction of cells",
    title = "Cell type composition along trajectory with pseudotime windows"
  ) +

  # Y-axis expansion
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.5))) +

  # X-axis breaks only at the last cell of each window
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = x_breaks,
    labels = x_breaks,
    expand = c(0, 0),
    limits = c(min(plot_long$cell_rank_numeric), max(plot_long$cell_rank_numeric))
  ) +

  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1))

p
```

# Fisher's exact test (DEGs)

## Calculate DEGs

DE analysis, for all pseudotime_windows.
```{r}
se
DefaultAssay(se) <- "RNA"

se <- SetIdent(se, value = "pseudotime_windows")

DEG_genes_all_tested <- FindAllMarkers(se, only.pos = TRUE, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.25,slot = "data", return.thresh = 1)

DEG_genes <- subset(DEG_genes_all_tested, subset = p_val_adj <= 0.05) # using only significant DEG
```


Save DEG results
```{r, eval=T}
write.table(DEG_genes_all_tested,file="DEG_output/DEG_genes_all_tested_MDD_sliding.csv", col.names = T, row.names = F,quote = FALSE,sep = ";")
```


## Fisher's exact test


```{r, eval=FALSE}
run_fisher_test_degs_v3 <- function(se, DEG_genes, OT_genes, adjust_method = "bonferroni", test_alternative = "greater") {
  
  total_genes <- rownames(se)
  
  # Prepare lists to store results
  fisher_results_list <- list()
  
  for (cluster in unique(DEG_genes$cluster)) {
    cluster_data <- DEG_genes[DEG_genes$cluster == cluster, ]
    cluster_data$Genetically_Associated <- cluster_data$gene %in% OT_genes
    
    # Counts
    A <- sum(cluster_data$Genetically_Associated) # DEG & OT
    C <- length(cluster_data$gene) - A # DEG & not OT
    not_DE_genes <- setdiff(total_genes, cluster_data$gene)
    B <- sum(not_DE_genes %in% OT_genes) # non-DEG & OT
    D <- length(not_DE_genes) - B # non-DEG & not OT
    
    # 2x2 contingency table
    fisher_matrix <- matrix(c(A, B, C, D), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE,
                            dimnames = list(c("DEG", "Not_DEG"), c("OT_gene", "Not_OT_gene")))
    
    # Fisher test
    fisher_test <- fisher.test(fisher_matrix, alternative = test_alternative)
    
    # Proportions
    prop_DEG <- A / (A + C)
    prop_background <- B / (B + D)
    
    # OR and log2_OR
    OR <- (A * D) / (B * C)
    log2_OR <- log2(OR)
    
    # Combine everything in one row
    fisher_results_list[[cluster]] <- data.frame(
      cluster = cluster,
      A = A, C = C, B = B, D = D,
      prop_DEG = prop_DEG,
      prop_background = prop_background,
      OR = OR,
      log2_OR = log2_OR,
      CI_lower = fisher_test$conf.int[1],
      CI_upper = fisher_test$conf.int[2],
      p_value = fisher_test$p.value,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
  
  # Combine all clusters
  fisher_results <- do.call(rbind, fisher_results_list)
  
  # Adjust p-values
  fisher_results$adj_p_value <- p.adjust(fisher_results$p_value, method = adjust_method)
  
  return(fisher_results)
}

```

```{r}
desired_levels <- paste0("pt_window_", 1:length(table(se$pseudotime_windows)))  

# Convert 'cluster' to a factor with this order
fisher_pt_window_results_all_genes$cluster <- factor(fisher_pt_window_results_all_genes$cluster, levels = desired_levels)

# Reorder the rows based on the factor
fisher_pt_window_results_all_genes <- fisher_pt_window_results_all_genes[order(fisher_pt_window_results_all_genes$cluster), ]

# View the reordered table
fisher_pt_window_results_all_genes
```

# Summary plot


```{r, fig.height=12, fig.width=18}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggnewscale)

# -------------------------------
# Prepare metadata
# -------------------------------
meta <- se[[]]
cell_types <- c("NSC", "INP", "NB", "YGN", "GN")

meta$cell_rank_ordered <- factor(
  meta$cell_rank_ordered,
  levels = sort(unique(meta$cell_rank_ordered)),
  ordered = TRUE
)

plot_long <- meta %>%
  filter(cell_anno %in% cell_types) %>%
  count(cell_rank_ordered, cell_anno, name = "Count") %>%
  group_by(cell_rank_ordered) %>%
  mutate(Fraction = Count / sum(Count)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  rename(CellType = cell_anno)

cell_order <- c("NSC", "INP", "NB", "YGN", "GN")
plot_long$CellType <- factor(plot_long$CellType, levels = cell_order)

cell_colors <- c(
  "NSC" = "#FC8D62",
  "INP" = "#E78AC3",
  "NB"  = "#8DA0CB",
  "YGN" = "#A6D854",
  "GN"  = "#66C2A5"
)

# -------------------------------
# Pseudotime windows
# -------------------------------
window_labels <- meta %>%
  filter(!is.na(pseudotime_windows)) %>%
  group_by(pseudotime_windows) %>%
  summarise(
    start = min(as.numeric(cell_rank_ordered)),
    end   = max(as.numeric(cell_rank_ordered)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(xpos = (start + end)/2)

window_starts <- window_labels$start[-1]

# -------------------------------
# rectangle_1: Odds Ratio color
# -------------------------------
fisher_results_plot <- fisher_pt_window_results %>%
  dplyr::select(cluster, adj_p_value, OR) %>%
  inner_join(
    window_labels %>% dplyr::select(pseudotime_windows, start, end),
    by = c("cluster" = "pseudotime_windows")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    logp = -log10(adj_p_value),
    xmin = start,
    xmax = end,
    ymin = 1.02,
    ymax = 1.07,
    stars = case_when(
      adj_p_value < 0.001 ~ "",
      adj_p_value < 0.01  ~ "",
      adj_p_value < 0.05  ~ "",
      TRUE                ~ ""
    ),
    xmid = (xmin + xmax)/2,
    ymid = (ymin + ymax)/2,
    log2_OR = log2(OR)
  )

# -------------------------------
# rectangle_2: adj_p_value significance stars
# -------------------------------
fisher_results_plot2 <- fisher_pt_window_results %>%
  dplyr::select(cluster, adj_p_value) %>%
  inner_join(
    window_labels %>% dplyr::select(pseudotime_windows, start, end),
    by = c("cluster" = "pseudotime_windows")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    xmin = start,
    xmax = end,
    ymin = 1.03,
    ymax = 1.125,
    sig = factor(
      ifelse(adj_p_value < 0.05, "Significant", "Not significant"),
      levels = c("Not significant", "Significant")
    ),
    stars = case_when(
      adj_p_value < 0.0001 ~ "****",
      adj_p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      adj_p_value < 0.01  ~ "**",
      adj_p_value < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE                ~ ""
    ),
    xmid = (xmin + xmax)/2,
    ymid = (ymin + ymax)/2
  )

sig_colors <- c(
  "Not significant" = "transparent",
  "Significant"     = "transparent"
)

# -------------------------------
# X-axis breaks aligned to windows
# -------------------------------
x_breaks <- window_labels$start
x_labels <- window_labels$start   # numeric labels; could use window names if preferred

# -------------------------------
# Plot
# -------------------------------
p <- ggplot(plot_long, aes(x = cell_rank_ordered, y = Fraction, fill = CellType)) +

  # Bars
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1) +

  # Window dashed lines
  geom_vline(xintercept = window_starts - 0.5,
             linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +

  # Window labels on top, rotated 90°
  geom_text(
    data = window_labels,
    aes(x = xpos, y = 1.13, label = pseudotime_windows),  # just above p-value stars
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    angle = 90,
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 0.5,
    size = 6
  ) +

  # Cell type colors
  scale_fill_manual(values = cell_colors, name = "Cell Type") +

  # -------------------------------
  # rectangle_1: log2(OR)
  # -------------------------------
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
  geom_rect(
    data = fisher_results_plot,
    aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, fill = log2_OR),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = NA
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = fisher_results_plot,
    aes(x = xmid, y = ymid, label = stars),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 5
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "D", direction = 1,
                       name = "log2(OR)") +

  # -------------------------------
  # rectangle_2: significance stars
  # -------------------------------
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
  geom_rect(
    data = fisher_results_plot2,
    aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, fill = sig),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = NA,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = fisher_results_plot2,
    aes(x = xmid, y = ymid, label = stars),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 10
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = sig_colors, name = "Significance") +

  # X-axis breaks = start of windows
  scale_x_discrete(
    breaks = levels(meta$cell_rank_ordered)[x_breaks],
    labels = x_labels
  ) +

  # Y-axis expanded to fit labels
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.18))) +

  # Labels
  labs(
    x = "Cell rank",
    y = "Fraction of cells",
    title = "Top genes MDD: cell type composition along trajectory with pseudotime windows"
  ) +

  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 15),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 15),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 15),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 15),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold")
  ) +

  # Allow overhanging text to appear
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off")

p

```

```{r, fig.height=6, fig.width=18}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggnewscale)

# -------------------------------
# Prepare metadata
# -------------------------------
meta <- se[[]]
cell_types <- c("NSC", "INP", "NB", "YGN", "GN")

# Keep as factor for correct dashed lines
meta$cell_rank_ordered <- factor(
  meta$cell_rank_ordered,
  levels = sort(unique(meta$cell_rank_ordered)),
  ordered = TRUE
)

# Prepare plot_long
plot_long <- meta %>%
  filter(cell_anno %in% cell_types) %>%
  count(cell_rank_ordered, cell_anno, name = "Count") %>%
  group_by(cell_rank_ordered) %>%
  mutate(Fraction = Count / sum(Count)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  rename(CellType = cell_anno)

# Set cell type order and colors
cell_order <- c("NSC", "INP", "NB", "YGN", "GN")
plot_long$CellType <- factor(plot_long$CellType, levels = cell_order)

cell_colors <- c(
  "NSC" = "#FC8D62",
  "INP" = "#E78AC3",
  "NB"  = "#8DA0CB",
  "YGN" = "#A6D854",
  "GN"  = "#66C2A5"
)

# -------------------------------
# Pseudotime window positions
# -------------------------------
window_labels <- meta %>%
  filter(!is.na(pseudotime_windows)) %>%
  group_by(pseudotime_windows) %>%
  summarise(
    start = min(as.numeric(cell_rank_ordered)),
    end   = max(as.numeric(cell_rank_ordered)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(start) %>%  # Sort by start to ensure correct order
  mutate(xpos = (start + end)/2)

# Dashed lines at end of each window except last
window_ends_pos <- sapply(window_labels$end, function(x) which(levels(meta$cell_rank_ordered) == as.character(x)))
window_ends_pos <- window_ends_pos[-length(window_ends_pos)]

# X-axis labels: last cell of each window
label_ranks <- levels(meta$cell_rank_ordered)[sapply(window_labels$end, function(x) which(levels(meta$cell_rank_ordered) == as.character(x)))]

# -------------------------------
# rectangle_1: Odds Ratio
# -------------------------------
fisher_results_plot <- fisher_pt_window_results %>%
  dplyr::select(cluster, adj_p_value, OR) %>%
  inner_join(
    window_labels %>% dplyr::select(pseudotime_windows, start, end),
    by = c("cluster" = "pseudotime_windows")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    xmin = start - 0.4,
    xmax = end + 0.4,
    ymin = 1.02,
    ymax = 1.07,
    stars = "",
    xmid = (xmin + xmax)/2,
    ymid = (ymin + ymax)/2,
    log2_OR = log2(OR)
  )

# -------------------------------
# rectangle_2: significance stars
# -------------------------------
fisher_results_plot2 <- fisher_pt_window_results %>%
  dplyr::select(cluster, adj_p_value) %>%
  inner_join(
    window_labels %>% dplyr::select(pseudotime_windows, start, end),
    by = c("cluster" = "pseudotime_windows")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    xmin = start - 0.4,
    xmax = end + 0.4,
    ymin = 1.03,
    ymax = 1.125,
    sig = factor(
      ifelse(adj_p_value < 0.05, "Significant", "Not significant"),
      levels = c("Not significant", "Significant")
    ),
    stars = case_when(
      adj_p_value < 0.0001 ~ "****",
      adj_p_value < 0.001  ~ "***",
      adj_p_value < 0.01   ~ "**",
      adj_p_value < 0.05   ~ "*",
      TRUE                 ~ ""
    ),
    xmid = (xmin + xmax)/2,
    ymid = (ymin + ymax)/2
  )

sig_colors <- c(
  "Not significant" = "transparent",
  "Significant"     = "transparent"
)

# -------------------------------
# Plot
# -------------------------------
p <- ggplot(plot_long, aes(x = cell_rank_ordered, y = Fraction, fill = CellType)) +

  # Bars
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1) +

  # Window dashed lines
  geom_vline(xintercept = window_ends_pos + 0.5,
             linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +

  # Window labels on top
  geom_text(
    data = window_labels %>%
      mutate(label_num = sub(".*_", "", pseudotime_windows)),
    aes(x = xpos, y = 1.13, label = label_num),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    angle = 0,
    hjust = 0.5,
    vjust = -0.3,
    size = 6
  ) +

  # Cell type colors
  scale_fill_manual(values = cell_colors, name = "Cell Type") +

  # rectangle_1: log2(OR)
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
  geom_rect(
    data = fisher_results_plot,
    aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, fill = log2_OR),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = NA
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = fisher_results_plot,
    aes(x = xmid, y = ymid, label = stars),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 5
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "D", direction = 1,
                       name = "log2(OR)") +

  # rectangle_2: significance stars
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
  geom_rect(
    data = fisher_results_plot2,
    aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, fill = sig),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = NA,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = fisher_results_plot2,
    aes(x = xmid, y = ymid, label = stars),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 10
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = sig_colors, name = "Significance") +

  # X-axis: only last cell of each window
  scale_x_discrete(breaks = label_ranks) +

  # Y-axis limits
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.15), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.5)) +

  # Labels
  labs(
    x = "Cell rank",
    y = "Fraction of cells",
    title = "Top genes MDD: cell type composition along trajectory with pseudotime windows"

  theme_classic() +

    legend.title = element_text(size = 15),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 15),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold")
  )
```
